name: Bloodhoof Village
summary: Bloodhoof Village is a central tauren settlement resting along the banks of Stonebull Lake in Mulgore. Named in honor of the Bloodhoof tribe, it serves as the first major gathering hub for young hunters and braves journeying out from Camp Narache toward Thunder Bluff. Led by Baine Bloodhoof, the village coordinates local defense, trade, and traditional rites across the plains.

sections.title: Heart of the Plains
sections.body: Situated around the clear waters of Stonebull Lake, Bloodhoof Village is a bustling center of commerce, craft, and ceremony in central Mulgore. Young tauren departing their trials at Camp Narache arrive here to hone their skills before venturing onward to the great mesas of Thunder Bluff. It is also well-known across Kalimdor for its master drum makers and the patient breeders who tame wild kodo beasts for travel.

sections.title: Leadership and Rites
sections.body: Day-to-day governance and the defense of the region fall under Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Under his watchful eye, braves are dispatched to secure the grasslands against aggressive wildlife, quilboar encroachers, and the shadowy presence of the Venture Company. Alongside Baine, spiritual guides such as Zarlman Two-Moons tend to the inner life of the tribe, directing novices through sacred journeys like the Rite of Vision.

aliases: who is in charge of bloodhoof village
faq.answer: Baine Bloodhoof, son of High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, leads the settlement and directs its defenses against threats to the central plains.

faq.q: What major rites are conducted here?
faq.answer: Spiritual advisors such as Zarlman Two-Moons guide young tauren through the traditional Rite of Vision, an essential spiritual journey on the path to adulthood.

faq.q: What is the settlement known for producing?
faq.answer: Bloodhoof Village is famed for its uniquely crafted ceremony drums and is the primary hub where wild plains kodos are tamed and trained as mounts.

faq.q: Where do travelers go after finishing their tasks here?
faq.answer: Once their deeds in central Mulgore are complete, travelers are generally directed northward to Thunder Bluff, the capital city of the tauren.

angles.text: For young tauren, entering Bloodhoof Village marks the first real step beyond youth into broader tribal responsibility and spiritual maturity.
This peaceful settlement serves as a critical stopover and logistics link between the southern plains of Mulgore and the Horde capital at Thunder Bluff.
